simulate_scene: simulate a phyre scene for a specified number of physics steps and return scene states
simulate_task: simulate a phyre task with configurable steps and stride to get solution results
build_user_input: build user input from points or ball parameters for adding objects to a scene
add_user_input_to_scene: add user input bodies like boxes or balls to an existing phyre scene
simulate_task_with_input: simulate a phyre task with user input combined in a single call
